items.text: Supply chain disruptions and inflation aren’t just increasing our grocery bills, it's also impacting schools’ ability to serve healthy food to students. I met with the KY School Nutrition Association to discuss ways to continue providing KY students with healthy meals at school. https://t.co/nYe2mXg8Ci

I’m saddened to hear of the loss of Corporal Jacob Moore and 3 other Marines, who lost their lives in a NATO exercise crash. Moore of Catlettsburg was only 24 years old. We as a nation are grateful for their selfless sacrifices. I’ll be praying for the fallen Marines' families.

Bills I proposed to deliver substance use disorder prevention, treatment, and recovery support resources and aim to get medical innovation to patients faster once approved by the FDA are being considered in @HouseCommerce Health Subcommittee markup today.

.@SpectrumNews1KY reports on a bill that I’m the lead Republican of to deliver substance use disorder prevention, treatment, and recovery support resources to local entities, which passed the Health Subcommittee on Wednesday. https://t.co/Uwg0jRzahz

Today my bills passed out of @housecommerce that would:

➡️deliver treatment, prevention, and recovery support services
➡️help patients access medical innovation more quickly
➡️reauthorize user fees, secure our medical supply chain, and lower drug costs

@HouseCommerce Learn more about the Substance Use Prevention, Treatment, and Recovery Services Block Grant Act I'm co-leading, which is part of @cathymcmorris's bill to bolster mental health resources, & the FDA Act that includes my Pre-approval Information Exchange Act: https://t.co/pk8YBac3Gb

Kentucky’s newest overdose fatality report shows we lost 14.5% more people to overdoses in 2021 than 2020. A bill I’m pushing for and co-leading to provide treatment, prevention, and recovery support services recently passed the House, making it one step closer to becoming law. https://t.co/syRL93pLc5

I'll continue to listen to KY communities' solutions to best address the overdose crisis and fight for a 2-part approach to address this crisis: providing resources for treatment and recovery in addition to resources for law enforcement to get deadly drugs out of our communities.

During #RecoveryMonth, we celebrate Americans working hard to overcome substance use disorder and those in long-term recovery. I believe recovery is possible for everyone. That's why in Congress I fight for recovery and treatment resources for people who want help.

If you or someone you know needs help, please click below for treatment locator tools:
https://t.co/HW675fdMz5

I'm proud to again lead a bipartisan bill to support comprehensive opioid recovery centers. The need for wrap-around, coordinated treatment and recovery support resources for people who want to rebuild their lives cannot be overstated. Statement: https://t.co/mrS4O5eZ3z https://t.co/eNm5XX1zyL

I joined community members in Grayson County in observing the National Day of Prayer. Our Founding Fathers found this right so important to our democracy that they put this freedom in the First Amendment. I was proud to exercise the right to pray with community members. https://t.co/n0sCyjZZ82

As Chair of E&C's Health Subcommittee, I’m working to ensure that people who want to overcome their substance use disorder continue to have access to treatment & recovery services. Today I held a 2nd hearing as part of my efforts to reauthorize key programs that expire this year. https://t.co/c09HGmR4AS

As @Housecommerce Health Chair, I've worked to provide treatment and recovery access for those seeking overcome substance use disorder. My bill, the SUPPORT Act, works to get help to those most in need and keep illicit drugs off our streets to prevent overdoses entirely. https://t.co/FqGFLb7h8Y

My thoughts and prayers are with @SecDef amid his recent prostate cancer diagnosis.

But it is unacceptable that the White House and Pentagon were not alerted of his condition with national security threats looming. The American service members and citizens deserve better.

.@JellyRoll615’s testimony today is one of hope and recovery. He says it best- no one is too far gone. My SUPPORT Act which passed the House in December helps those struggling with substance use disorder get the treatment they need to save themselves.
https://t.co/69XT6AqugQ

Yesterday, I was proud to speak on the floor and vote in favor of the Protecting Health Care For All Patients Act, because individuals with disabilities and chronic conditions deserve access to treatment without a Washington bureaucrat making a decision for them. https://t.co/NobxC8M1mT
Today I visited Dishman McGinnis Elementary School in Bowling Green to speak with 5th graders, discuss child nutrition and school food programs. https://t.co/TVxSIKurzQ

This morning, I led the @housecommerce Health subcommittee hearing on rare diseases and how we can help increase patient access to treatment without limiting access to life saving cures. Check out my questions here: https://t.co/5aiNLDK4sV
I recently met with Feeding Kentucky to talk about child nutrition programs and how we can continue to help constituents back home. https://t.co/RMFx5tB9Cy

As Health Chair of @housecommerce, I’m committed to ensuring Americans receive care at affordable prices for patients across our nation. I met with the Graves Gilbert Clinic to discuss what I’m doing on @HouseCommerce to drive health care innovation and lower the costs of care for Americans and their families.

As Health Chair of @HouseCommerce, I’ve been a champion of protecting the innovation in health care which drives cures, treatments, and results for patients. I met with Kentuckians from the Pancreatic Cancer Action Network to hear about their experiences with this tragic disease and discuss how @HouseCommerce Health Subcommittee can support patients and their families beat pancreatic cancer once and for all.

I recently met with the Grayson County Food Alliance to discuss the important work they do to help members of our community with nutrition and other obstacles. I am proud to help support those who do so much to feed our communities and ensure no one across Grayson County or our 2nd District goes hungry.

Last week I visited Encompass Health Rehab Hospital at Lakeview in Elizabethtown to discuss concerns relating to access to long-term and acute care for our most vulnerable patients and the work I am doing as @housecommerce Health Subcommittee Chair to provide greater access to care for seniors.

I was proud to lead this letter to @BrooksLaSureCMS alongside @VernBuchanan and my @HouseGOP colleagues to hold the Biden-Harris admin accountable for their latest election year gimmick where they are attempting to buy down rising Medicare premiums ahead of an election because of their own policy failures. https://t.co/Om0cXW1uCu
